brand.name: Shetty's Desk
brand.type: Personal LinkedIn operating-scene and precision-artifact visual system
brand.essence: Optimistic, science-led, credible and modern. Clean and airy, with luminous blue gradients and a vivid signature green that always signals positive / progress / the smart choice. Data-driven but human. Standard posts use one native operating scene; the precision route uses smooth isometric 2.5D vector art on white.
brand.derivedFrom: EcoMobility infographic reference set (visual DNA extracted and generalized; subject matter is now topic-agnostic)

logo.mark: Textured chalk ring (hand-drawn, organic) above a serif 'Shetty's' wordmark with italic 'DESK'

terracotta.role: Logo ring — primary brand mark color

white.role: Logo wordmark on dark / mono variant

black.role: Identity canvas — logos live on dark

files.format: All four are 800x800 transparent PNGs — place on any surface (dark recommended)

usage.primary: Default. Avatar, profile, cover, watermark on dark or photographic surfaces.
usage.monoWhite: Single-color uses on dark or saturated surfaces (incl. navy #1939A5 panels).
usage.monoOlive: Single-color uses on light/cream surfaces; print.
rules: The logo layer is IDENTITY (terracotta/olive/black, textured, serif) and intentionally distinct from the CONTENT layer (azure/eco-green flat isometric on white). Don't mix the two palettes within one element.
On an approved carousel or exact artifact, a small exact logo may appear in the footer. Do not paste a logo over a standard native scene.
Keep clear space of at least the ring's quarter-width around the mark; don't recolor, stretch, outline, or add effects to the textured ring.

azure.role: Primary brand blue — the hero color

ecoGreen.role: SIGNATURE accent — positive / progress / highlight / the smart choice

mint.role: Light end of the signature green gradient

coral.role: Alert accent — negative / warning / the costly or old way (use sparingly)

blue.use: Infrastructure, scenes, UI surfaces, hero panels

eco.use: SIGNATURE — the positive/progress element in every graphic

semantics.blue: The world, the system, infrastructure, neutral subject matter
semantics.green: Positive, progress, growth, the smart/recommended choice, highlighted data
semantics.coral: Negative, warning, cost, friction, the old/inferior way (use sparingly)

typography.note: Reference uses a Gotham/Montserrat-style geometric sans; Poppins is the recommended free Google Fonts substitute. Montserrat is an equally good alternative.
typography.signatureMove: Mixed-weight stat callout: a huge 800-weight number beside small 300-weight uppercase supporting words (e.g. '97% OF THE TIME').

illustration.style: V4 Operating Studio: tangible native 2.5D operating scene; precision route: flat-design isometric / 2.5D vector

do: Isometric or front-flat vector with smooth gradient fills
Pure white / very light blue background
Signature green gradient reserved for the positive/highlight element
Soft, diffused long shadows under objects (never harsh or black)
Friendly mini-figures + green rounded speech bubbles for a human touch
Generous negative space; one clear focal object
dont: No hard black outlines or hand-drawn sketch look
Don't use green for anything negative/costly
No harsh or black drop shadows
Avoid clutter — keep it editorial and airy

motifs: Connected nodes, pipelines, routes & dashed paths
Lightbulbs, gears, targets, abstract concept icons

precisionArtifactLayoutAnatomy: 1. Pin header — number/topic badge + UPPERCASE title + thin azure rule fading right
2. Intro + character — short light paragraph paired with a mini-figure + green speech bubble
3. Concept row — 3-4 isometric icons, each a bold label + 1-line caption
4. Hero scene — one large isometric illustration centered with white space
5. Stat callout — oversized mixed-weight number (green=positive, coral=negative) + caption
6. Sources footer — centered small blue 'Sources:' list (credibility is part of the brand)

prompts.standardNativeSceneBlock: Create one original, image-engine-native Shetty's Desk Operating Studio scene for {reader and live work moment}. Make {one contested decision} visible through {one physical mechanism}. The reader must understand the tension at feed size and keep {one decision rule or mental object} at closer look. Use a luminous white or ice-blue operating world, azure-to-navy systems, eco-green only for the protected or recommended path, and coral only for real risk, friction, or exception. Render scene, hierarchy, and short integral typography as one final image. No HTML, SVG, cards, dashboard mosaic, pasted title bar, footer, watermark, or model-redrawn logo overlay. Do not invent numbers, outcomes, or company proof.
prompts.standardNativeSceneUsage: Default for an ordinary LinkedIn post. Choose a reader tension and physical mechanism first. Do not generate modules or assemble overlays after rendering.
prompts.styleBlock: Flat-design isometric 2.5D vector infographic illustration in the "Shetty's Desk" brand style. Smooth blue gradients (azure #2798FB through royal #247BE1 to deep navy #1939A5), rounded geometric shapes, soft diffused long shadows, subtle glows, clean editorial composition on a pure white background. A signature green eco-gradient (mint #8FF3CC to emerald #38E6A6) marks the positive / progress / highlighted element; coral-pink #E27199 marks any negative / warning element, used sparingly. Modern, optimistic, science-led, tech-forward. Crisp vector look — NOT photorealistic, no 3D render, no hard black outlines, no sketch texture, no dark backgrounds.
prompts.styleBlockUsage: Precision artifact or carousel only. It is not the default standard LinkedIn post route.
prompts.avoid: Avoid: photorealism, 3D renders, hard black outlines, sketch/hand-drawn texture, dark or busy backgrounds, clutter, harsh or black drop shadows, muddy gradients, and using green for anything negative.

precisionArtifactModules.hero: A single large isometric hero scene showing {subject}. One clear focal object centered with generous white space around it.
precisionArtifactModules.row: A horizontal row of 3-4 matching isometric concept icons illustrating {subject}. Identical style, scale and lighting across all icons, evenly spaced on white, each suitable for a bold label beneath it.
precisionArtifactModules.single: A single isometric concept icon representing {subject}, centered, with a soft long shadow, isolated on pure white.
precisionArtifactModules.stat: A bold infographic stat callout about {subject}: an oversized number as the focal point with a small isometric supporting illustration beside it.
precisionArtifactModules.compare: A side-by-side isometric comparison illustrating {subject}: two balanced halves, clean dividing space, matched perspective and scale.
precisionArtifactModules.scene: A wide isometric system scene showing {subject}: interconnected objects, nodes or paths, small figures, lots of airy white space.
precisionArtifactModules.header: A clean banner-style header graphic for the topic "{subject}": a blue map-pin or number badge and a thin azure underline rule, minimal, lots of white space, room for an uppercase title.

accentClauses.eco: Use the signature eco gradient (mint #8FF3CC to emerald #38E6A6 to azure) as the accent on the positive/highlighted element.
accentClauses.coral: Use coral-pink #E27199 sparingly to mark the negative / warning element.
accentClauses.both: Contrast a positive element (eco gradient mint #8FF3CC to emerald #38E6A6) against a negative element (coral-pink #E27199).
accentClauses.none: Keep the palette to blues only — calm and neutral, no green or coral accents.

textOptions.none: Do not include any text or numbers in the image.
textOptions.label: Include a short UPPERCASE label in a clean geometric sans-serif (Poppins/Montserrat style), deep blue #215DC3.
textOptions.stat: Include one large bold stat number (eco-green #38E6A6 if positive, deep blue if neutral) with a small light-weight uppercase caption beneath it.

tips: Attach 1-2 curated reference images and say 'keep the same flat isometric vector style'
Handles long descriptive prompts — keep the full style block intact
Renders legible in-image text — fine to request labels/stat numbers
State aspect ratio explicitly; iterate in the same chat
Ask for a row of matching icons in one shot for visual consistency
Lead with 'flat-design isometric vector infographic, pure white background' to lock style early
Reuse the identical style block across generations for a coherent series
Conversational refinement is its strength — start full, then nudge
Excellent text rendering — good for stat-callout modules
Ask for pure-white or transparent background so assets drop into layouts cleanly

claude-code.usage: For a standard LinkedIn post, read standardNativeSceneBlock and write one native image-engine prompt. Use HTML/SVG only for a separately selected precision artifact or carousel.
tips: Use this file as the single source of truth for all tokens
Do not add HTML/SVG, dashboard, title, footer, or logo layers over a standard native scene
Generate modules and use SVG/HTML only for a separately selected precision artifact or carousel

workflow: Standard LinkedIn post: choose one reader tension and physical mechanism, then render one coherent native image-engine scene with no HTML/SVG or dashboard overlay. Precision artifact or carousel: generate modules separately and assemble only when exact controlled layout is the reader value. Preserve palette, colour semantics, and material language across a series without forcing identical layouts.
